results.title: Blacklist & Inurfase pres. ZAAGSTEP by Dr Donk
results.sourceDescription:
BLACKLIST & INURFASE pres.

ZAAGSTEP by Dr Donk

For years, electronic music has been built on genres.

Zaag. Uptempo. Hard Dance. Dubstep. Drum & Bass. Bass Music.

But what happens when the boundaries between them disappear?

On September 11th, BLACKLIST and INURFASE invite you to witness the official launch of ZAAGSTEP - the sound created by Dr Donk that combines the high BPM intensity of Uptempo and Zaag with the energy, and influence of Bass Music.

A never-seen-before crossover between Dubstep, Zaag, Drum & Bass, Uptempo and everything in between. WELCOME TO ZAAGSTEP 😈

To celebrate his upcoming album release, Dr Donk presents the world's first full-scale ZAAGSTEP showcase at Bootshaus Cologne, featuring artists who have helped shape the sound and artists who represent the different worlds colliding within it.
